title: Cooldown Queue
statement: A printer runs jobs of different types, written as letters, one per minute. After a job of some type, the printer must wait at least gap minutes before running the same type again; it may idle. Jobs can run in any order. Return the fewest minutes to finish all jobs.

answerKey.pattern: Counting and a formula from the most frequent type
keyPoints: Let f be the highest count and k the number of types with that count
The busiest type needs (f − 1) blocks of gap + 1 minutes plus k at the end
The answer is max(total jobs, (f − 1) · (gap + 1) + k)
edgeCases: gap = 0: just the number of jobs
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Simulate minute by minute with a heap: O(answer · log 26)

hints: Which job type decides how long it takes?
Lay out the most frequent type with gap empty minutes between; the others fill the gaps.
Answer = max(jobs.length, (maxCount − 1) × (gap + 1) + number of types with maxCount).
